tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every card. The canvas is pure black so cards read as lit objects.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid secondary surfaces: sidebar environment box, mobile tab bar, edge labels.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside cards; ink drawn on top of coloured status glyphs (the cut-out in a check or cross icon).

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected segment, form fields, tooltip body, graph nodes, flow chips.

tokens.name: raised-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of graph nodes.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, raised and card gradients.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels, inactive nav. 7.3:1 on bg, 5.9:1 on raised.

tokens.name: muted-faint
tokens.usage: Line numbers in code views and route lists; empty marks in the capability matrix. Decorative only, never body text.

tokens.name: fill-4
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, nav items and list items; inset panels.

tokens.name: fill-6
tokens.usage: Search field, segmented control track, tag, kbd, help-tip button, step number.

tokens.name: fill-8
tokens.usage: Neutral pill background; empty dot in charts; radio track.

tokens.name: card-top
tokens.usage: Top-left (lightest) stop of the diagonal card gradient.

tokens.name: card-mid
tokens.usage: Mid stop (38%) of the diagonal card gradient.

tokens.name: card-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom-right (darkest) stop of the card gradient.

tokens.name: card-line
tokens.usage: 1px outline of a card.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Outline of code blocks and docs cells.

tokens.name: quick-action
tokens.usage: Resting fill of quick action tiles and docs cells.

tokens.name: quick-action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of quick action tiles.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of docs code blocks.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, "Show more", running state, focus ring, selected node ring, active radio. 5.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Running / info pill (text: brand).

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighted line in the YAML view.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Succeeded, online, valid, passed checks, added lines, heartbeat received.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the success pill (text: ok).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failed, invalid, removed lines, destructive button text.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the failure pill and the Reject button (text: bad).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a human: approvals, degraded runners, warnings, L3 blast radius, nav counter.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the warning pill and nav counter (text: warn).

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Row highlight for an event or file that needs a decision.

tokens.name: silver-top
tokens.usage: Top (end) stop of the silver primary button gradient.

tokens.name: silver-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom (start) stop of the silver primary button gradient.

tokens.name: on-silver
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the silver primary button.

tokens.name: button-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the default button gradient.

tokens.name: button-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the default button gradient.

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: YAML keys in the code view.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings in the code view and text in docs code blocks.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers in the code view.

tokens.name: code-var
tokens.usage: Template variables in the code view.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Docs article title. Once per view.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Project overview KPI numbers. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Run Inspector stats (wall clock, node time). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: No account needed. Runner, project, first graph.
styles.usage: Docs intro paragraph, in muted, max 620px wide.

styles.name: link-more
styles.usage: "Show more" link at the foot of a card, in brand.

styles.name: breadcrumb
styles.usage: Top bar breadcrumb; the current page in fg, ancestors in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, fields, buttons, card subtitles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Item titles inside lists and quick actions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section and column labels, in muted. Write the text in sentence case; CSS uppercases it.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: YAML editor and docs code blocks.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Event names, file paths, durations, run ids.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags: versions, ids, short machine values.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Chart axes, kbd hints, node type line, edge labels.
